Payout of 17 July is short ₹136.19.
The bank credited ₹2,15,814.13 against an expected ₹2,15,950.32. 21 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000090 of ₹136.19, issued 9 August against payment pay_000816. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000090 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000090 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
